title: Interesting Potions
description: This adds many potions I randomly thought of. I will be adding more over time!
body:
This is just me messing about with some ideas on what I could turn into potions!
Not all have recipes as this is mainly just a test version haha

Potions:
- Death (Kills you)
- Insanity (Paralyses you) (WIP)
- Steroids (Makes your strength incredibly strong)
- To the Heavens (Makes you levitate so high up that you fly through the clouds)
- Rifted (Teleports you high in the sky in a random area) (similar to "To the Heavens")
- Boxed In (Creates an open space deep underground and teleports the entity in that space)
- The Pathwalker (Creates a temporary path as you walk midair)
- Moon Gravity (Lowers your gravity) (WIP as does not decrease fall damage)
